offering_description.value: Dropbox sells cloud file storage and collaboration tools to individuals, independent professionals, and organizations. It delivers them through web, desktop, and mobile apps and offers tools for workplace search, electronic signatures, secure document sharing, and video review.

primary_products.value: file synchronization and collaboration software; workplace search software; electronic signature software; document sharing and analytics software; video review software

primary_services.value: cloud file storage and backup; secure file transfer and document hosting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Independent professionals, creative agencies, small businesses, and enterprise teams; B2C: Individuals storing, backing up, and sharing personal files

end_markets.value: personal cloud storage; business productivity and collaboration; professional services; media and creative production; sales and fundraising

revenue_model.value: subscription: Individual and team plans for storage, collaboration, workplace search, electronic signatures, and document sharing

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Builds applications that help individuals and organizations store, sync, find, share, and sign digital files; service provider: Hosts and backs up files for individuals and organizations

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Cloud file management, collaboration, workplace search, electronic signatures, secure document sharing, and video review

distribution_channels.value: online: Self-service sign-ups and upgrades through company websites and apps; direct sales: Sales teams serving business and enterprise accounts; partners / resellers: IT resellers and managed service providers serving business customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Cloud processing of personal data under the GDPR and California privacy law, plus electronic signature rules such as E-SIGN and eIDAS
